defaultKeyType: defaultKeyType must be ed25519 or rsa4096
keyFolder: keyFolder must be a path or null
keyFolderInvalid: the key folder path is invalid
keyFolderNotLocal: the key folder must be a full local path, or one starting with ~/
keyFolderSpaces: the key folder must be a path without surrounding spaces
language: language must be system, en or fr
notAnObject: the settings must be an object
terminalFontSize: terminalFontSize must be a whole number from {min} to {max}
theme: theme must be system, light or dark
